message.content:
An editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated "18-24 SEPTEMBER 2017," features an inverted human figure submerged in a turquoise, bubbly liquid. The man, depicted with dark hair and closed eyes, is positioned upside down, filling the central vertical space. He wears a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt and trousers. Chains wrap around his torso and arms, secured by two large, metallic padlocks with keyholes. His hands are near his chest, one partially clenched and the other open. Small, translucent bubbles of various sizes surround his body, concentrated around the chains and his head.

The background is a solid turquoise gradient with scattered white spots. Large, white block letters at the bottom read "SIASAT LEPAS SETYA NOVANTO." At the top, black text reads "INVESTIGASI: CARA KILAT JADI DOKTOR" and "ANCAMAN BAJA RONGSOKAN DARI CINA." A red vertical bar borders the left edge. A barcode and technical details, including "RP 45.000" and "ISSN: 0126-4273," are located in the lower-left corner. The partially obscured word "TEMPO" appears behind the figure's legs.
